text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Senpai. Thank you very much. But...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Are you going to congratulate me every 
single time we meet? Geez, how many times 
has it been now...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Birthdays only come once a year, boss! 
Don't you just wanna celebrate to the 
absolute fullest?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is the super special day City was 
born! Because of today, we were able to 
meet!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah, but... It'd really surprise 
everyone around us.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I've already received plenty this year. 
...Please save it for next year.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way! We're gonna celebrate big-time 
next year, too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna hear it until the day is 
over! —Happy birthday, City!
